title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

series.title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

fullText.simplified:
第九章、皇宫旧事

    从银作局出来，包拯和公孙策的心情都很沉重。二十一年前的李妃、冷宫和火灾，没有一个是简单的。包拯和公孙策都只有三十多岁，虽然二十一年前他们只是十来岁的小孩，但当年皇宫里的那场大火他们还是知道的。当然，比起那场大火，人们议论更多的妖女李妃生狸猫的传闻，他们也是听说过的。
    这都是二十一年前的旧事。那时候，先皇还很年轻，他没有皇后，但有两个喜欢的贵妃，一个姓刘，叫刘妃；一个姓李，叫李妃。刘妃和李妃都很漂亮，关系也很好，她们同时进宫，同时被封为贵妃，又几乎同时怀孕。先皇特别高兴，他告诉城中百姓，他很快将迎来两个孩子。这两个孩子谁先出生，并且是男孩，谁就是将来的太子，而孩子的母亲就是皇后。
    十个月后，李妃先生产了，但她生下来的孩子不是人，而是一只没有皮的狸猫。这把宫里所有人都吓坏了，都说李妃是妖怪，是狸猫变的，所以生下来的也是狸猫。年轻的先皇也被吓到了，他把刚生产完的李妃打入了冷宫，但没想到李妃住进去的第二天晚上，冷宫就发生了一场意外。一个宫女不小心在睡梦中打翻了烛台，烛火烧到了被子，被子烧到了床，床烧到了房子，房子烧到了院子。火越烧越大，烧了整整一夜，李妃和冷宫里的宫女、太监都被烧死了。
    火灾后不久，怀孕的刘妃也生产了，她生下了一个儿子，就是后来的太子。刘妃因为李妃的死和冷宫的大火受到了惊吓，皇帝很担心，很快就封她做了皇后。虽然刘妃做了皇后，但她过得也不是很好，太子十七岁时生病死了。太子是先皇唯一的儿子，也是刘妃唯一的孩子，太子的死对她的打击特别大，她大病了一场。后来先皇把八王爷的儿子——也就是现在的皇帝赵真接进皇宫，从小没有母亲的赵真就成了刘妃的儿子。虽然不是亲生的，但刘妃对赵真很好，把他当亲生儿子一样照顾。赵真对刘妃也不错，在心里把她当成了母亲。先皇死后，刘妃就成了太后，赵真对她还是一样好，现在她是宫里身份最尊贵的人了。
    这些都是以前的旧事，但现在因为一枝老旧的珠花被挖了出来。虽然包拯不明白这些旧事和八王爷被绑架一案有什么关系，但他知道，绑架八王爷的人希望包拯去查阅这些旧事，难道——难道这些旧事里有外人不知道的事情？
    要想解开旧事，首先要见旧人。包拯决定去见尊贵的太后。
fullText.traditional:
第九章、皇宮舊事

    從銀作局出來，包拯和公孫策的心情都很沉重。二十一年前的李妃、冷宮和火災，沒有一個是簡單的。包拯和公孫策都只有三十多歲，雖然二十一年前他們只是十來歲的小孩，但當年皇宮裡的那場大火他們還是知道的。當然，比起那場大火，人們議論更多的妖女李妃生狸貓的傳聞，他們也是聽說過的。
    這都是二十一年前的舊事。那時候，先皇還很年輕，他沒有皇后，但有兩個喜歡的貴妃，一個姓劉，叫劉妃；一個姓李，叫李妃。劉妃和李妃都很漂亮，關係也很好，她們同時進宮，同時被封為貴妃，又幾乎同時懷孕。先皇特別高興，他告訴城中百姓，他很快將迎來兩個孩子。這兩個孩子誰先出生，並且是男孩，誰就是將來的太子，而孩子的母親就是皇后。
    十個月後，李妃先生產了，但她生下來的孩子不是人，而是一隻沒有皮的狸貓。這把宮裡所有人都嚇壞了，都說李妃是妖怪，是狸貓變的，所以生下來的也是狸貓。年輕的先皇也被嚇到了，他把剛生產完的李妃打入了冷宮，但沒想到李妃住進去的第二天晚上，冷宮就發生了一場意外。一個宮女不小心在睡夢中打翻了燭臺，燭火燒到了被子，被子燒到了床，床燒到了房子，房子燒到了院子。火越燒越大，燒了整整一夜，李妃和冷宮裡的宮女、太監都被燒死了。
    火災後不久，懷孕的劉妃也生產了，她生下了一個兒子，就是後來的太子。劉妃因為李妃的死和冷宮的大火受到了驚嚇，皇帝很擔心，很快就封她做了皇后。雖然劉妃做了皇后，但她過得也不是很好，太子十七歲時生病死了。太子是先皇唯一的兒子，也是劉妃唯一的孩子，太子的死對她的打擊特別大，她大病了一場。後來先皇把八王爺的兒子——也就是現在的皇帝趙真接進皇宮，從小沒有母親的趙真就成了劉妃的兒子。雖然不是親生的，但劉妃對趙真很好，把他當親生兒子一樣照顧。趙真對劉妃也不錯，在心裡把她當成了母親。先皇死後，劉妃就成了太后，趙真對她還是一樣好，現在她是宮裡身份最尊貴的人了。
    這些都是以前的舊事，但現在因為一枝老舊的珠花被挖了出來。雖然包拯不明白這些舊事和八王爺被綁架一案有什麼關係，但他知道，綁架八王爺的人希望包拯去查閱這些舊事，難道——難道這些舊事裡有外人不知道的事情？
    要想解開舊事，首先要見舊人。包拯決定去見尊貴的太后。

sentences.simplified: 火灾后不久，怀孕的刘妃也生产了，她生下了一个儿子，就是后来的太子。
sentences.traditional: 火災後不久，懷孕的劉妃也生產了，她生下了一個兒子，就是後來的太子。

sentences.english: Shortly after the fire, the pregnant Consort Liu also gave birth. She had a son, who was the future crown prince.

sentences.simplified: 刘妃因为李妃的死和冷宫的大火受到了惊吓，

sentences.english: Consort Liu was terrified by Consort Li’s death and the great fire in the Cold Palace.

sentences.simplified: 皇帝很担心，很快就封她做了皇后。

sentences.traditional: 趙真對劉妃也不錯，在心裡把她當成了母親。
sentences.pinyin: zhào zhēn duì liú fēi yě bú cuò zài xīn lǐ bǎ tā dāng chéng le mǔ qīn
sentences.english: Zhao Zhen also treated Consort Liu very well, considering her to be his mother in his heart.

sentences.simplified: 先皇死后，刘妃就成了太后，
sentences.traditional: 先皇死後，劉妃就成了太后，
sentences.pinyin: xiān huáng sǐ hòu liú fēi jiù chéng le tài hòu
sentences.english: After the late emperor’s death, Consort Liu became the empress dowager.

sentences.simplified: 赵真对她还是一样好，现在她是宫里身份最尊贵的人了。
sentences.traditional: 趙真對她還是一樣好，現在她是宮裡身份最尊貴的人了。
sentences.pinyin: zhào zhēn duì tā hái shi yí yàng hǎo xiàn zài tā shì gōng lǐ shēn fèn zuì zūn guì de rén le
sentences.english: Zhao Zhen still treated her just as well, and she was now the most esteemed person in the palace.

sentences.simplified: 这些都是以前的旧事，但现在因为一枝老旧的珠花被挖了出来。
sentences.traditional: 這些都是以前的舊事，但現在因為一枝老舊的珠花被挖了出來。
sentences.pinyin: zhè xiē dōu shì yǐ qián de jiù shì dàn xiàn zài yīn wèi yì zhī lǎo jiù de zhū huā bèi wā le chu lai
sentences.english: These are all events from the past, but now, because of an old hairpin, they have been dug up.

sentences.simplified: 虽然包拯不明白这些旧事和八王爷被绑架一案有什么关系，
sentences.traditional: 雖然包拯不明白這些舊事和八王爺被綁架一案有什麼關係，
sentences.pinyin: suī rán bāo zhěng bù míng bai zhè xiē jiù shì hé bā wáng ye bèi bǎng jià yí àn yǒu shén me guān xi
sentences.english: Although Bao Zheng did not understand the connection between these events and the kidnapping of the Eighth Prince, ..

sentences.simplified: 但他知道，绑架八王爷的人希望包拯去查阅这些旧事，
sentences.traditional: 但他知道，綁架八王爺的人希望包拯去查閱這些舊事，
sentences.pinyin: dàn tā zhī dào bǎng jià bā wáng ye de rén xī wàng bāo zhěng qù chá yuè zhè xiē jiù shì
sentences.english: .. he knew that the Eighth Prince’s kidnapper wanted him to investigate these events.

sentences.simplified: 难道——难道这些旧事里有外人不知道的事情？
sentences.traditional: 難道——難道這些舊事裡有外人不知道的事情？
sentences.pinyin: nán dào nán dào zhè xiē jiù shì lǐ yǒu wài rén bù zhī dào de shì qing
sentences.english: Could it be, could it be that within these past events, there are things that outsiders don’t know about?

sentences.simplified: 要想解开旧事，首先要见旧人。
sentences.traditional: 要想解開舊事，首先要見舊人。
sentences.pinyin: yào xiǎng jiě kāi jiù shì shǒu xiān yào jiàn jiù rén
sentences.english: To unravel the past events, one must first meet the people from the past.

sentences.simplified: 包拯决定去见尊贵的太后。
sentences.traditional: 包拯決定去見尊貴的太后。
sentences.pinyin: bāo zhěng jué dìng qù jiàn zūn guì de tài hòu
sentences.english: Bao Zheng decided to go and see the esteemed empress dowager.

sentence_translations: Chapter 9: Past Events at Palace
After leaving the Palace Jewelry Bureau, both Bao Zheng and Gongsun Ce felt very heavy-hearted.
The events from twenty-one years ago involving Consort Li, the Cold Palace, and the fire were not simple.
Bao Zheng and Gongsun Ce were both just over thirty years old.
Although twenty-one years ago they were just children around ten years old, they still knew about the great fire in the palace back then.
Of course, compared to that great fire, people talked more about the rumor that the demon Consort Li gave birth to a leopard cat.
They had also heard about it.
This was an event from twenty-one years ago.
At that time, the late emperor was still very young. He did not have an empress, but he had two favored noble consorts.
One was surnamed Liu and was called Consort Liu; the other was surnamed Li and was called Consort Li.
Consort Liu and Consort Li were both very beautiful and had a good relationship.
They both entered the palace at the same time, were conferred the title of noble consort at the same time, ..
.. and became pregnant at almost the same time.
The late emperor was particularly happy. He told the people of the city that he would soon welcome two children.
Whichever of these two children was born first and was a boy would be the future crown prince, and the child’s mother would be the empress.
Ten months later, Consort Li gave birth. However, the child she gave birth to was not a human, but a skinned leopard cat.
This frightened everyone in the palace.
They all said that Consort Li was a demon who was transformed from a leopard cat, so she also gave birth to a leopard cat.
The young emperor was also frightened. He banished Consort Li, who had just given birth, to the Cold Palace.
But unexpectedly, on the second night after Consort Li moved in, an accident occurred in the Cold Palace.
A palace maid accidentally knocked over a candlestick in her sleep.
The candle flame burned the quilt, the quilt burned the bed, the bed burned the house, and the house burned the courtyard.
The fire grew larger and larger, burning throughout the entire night.
Consort Li, along with the palace maids and eunuchs in the Cold Palace, were all burned to death.
Shortly after the fire, the pregnant Consort Liu also gave birth. She had a son, who was the future crown prince.
Consort Liu was terrified by Consort Li’s death and the great fire in the Cold Palace.
The emperor was very worried and quickly made her the empress.
Although Consort Liu became the empress, her life wasn’t easy. When the crown prince was seventeen years old, he died of illness.
The crown prince was the late emperor’s only son and Consort Liu’s only child.
The death of the crown prince was a particularly heavy blow to her, and she fell seriously ill.
Later, the late emperor brought the son of the Eighth Prince, who was now Emperor Zhao Zhen, into the imperial palace.
Zhao Zhen, who was without a mother from a young age, became Consort Liu’s son.
Although he wasn’t her biological child, Consort Liu treated Zhao Zhen very well, caring for him as if he were her own son.
Zhao Zhen also treated Consort Liu very well, considering her to be his mother in his heart.
After the late emperor’s death, Consort Liu became the empress dowager.
Zhao Zhen still treated her just as well, and she was now the most esteemed person in the palace.
These are all events from the past, but now, because of an old hairpin, they have been dug up.
Although Bao Zheng did not understand the connection between these events and the kidnapping of the Eighth Prince, ..
.. he knew that the Eighth Prince’s kidnapper wanted him to investigate these events.
Could it be, could it be that within these past events, there are things that outsiders don’t know about?
To unravel the past events, one must first meet the people from the past.
Bao Zheng decided to go and see the esteemed empress dowager.
